# web-shell byte-identity corpus (neutralized vendored copies)

These fixtures are mechanical copies of the Surfspace `/next` web-shell
sources with a third-party-name / real-address substitution applied to prose
and text runs only — no directive, attribute or nesting changes, so both
backends render exactly the same block kinds and the byte-identity property
is unaffected.

The vendoring/neutralization tool (which carries the substitution table)
lives with the SOURCE of these files, in the private application repo:
`scripts/vendor-web-shell-fixtures.sh`. Re-run it there to resync; do not
hand-edit the copies here.
